title: A worker's own test is graded red on base and green on merge across merged outside rows
body:
Why: Fable 1115b slice 3; gives test-first a signal without new runs.
Outcome: new scripts/outside-testgrade.ts checks each merged row: worker's own test red on base, green on merge.
Proof: table in evals/ over >=9 merged row SHAs. Free.
